  chunkIndex?: number;

  endChar?: number;

/** Embedding id. */

/** End char. */
const endChar = ref<number>(generatedProps.endChar ?? 0);
/** Id. */
const id = ref<string>(generatedProps.id ?? '');
/** Display projection of content; retain the complete source field. */
const label = ref<string>(generatedProps.label ?? '');
/** Next chunk id. */
const nextChunkId = ref<string>(generatedProps.nextChunkId ?? '');
/** Hint copy surfaced in form fields when the label is empty. */
const placeholder = ref<string>(generatedProps.placeholder ?? '');
/** Prev chunk id. */
const prevChunkId = ref<string>(generatedProps.prevChunkId ?? '');
/** Start char. */
const startChar = ref<number>(generatedProps.startChar ?? 0);
/** Token count. */
const tokenCount = ref<number>(generatedProps.tokenCount ?? 0);

const handleChange_chunk_indexState = ref<string>(String(chunkIndex.value ?? ''));
const setHandleChange_chunk_indexState = (value: string) => { handleChange_chunk_indexState.value = value; };
/* @oods-local-binding handleChange_chunk_index */ const handleChange_chunk_index = (value: string) => { setHandleChange_chunk_indexState(value); };
const handleUpdate_embedding_idState = ref<string>(String(embeddingId.value ?? ''));

/* @oods-local-binding handleUpdate_embedding_id */ const handleUpdate_embedding_id = (value: string) => { setHandleUpdate_embedding_idState(value); };
</script>
